messages:
marta: Heads-up 1q6b-int4 bring-up found a concentrated failure mode on longform instruction chains ( >800 tokens ). Looks like truncation/kv-cache alignment + quant noise. Can't roll the canary until we tighten golden coverage for those slices.

jonathan: Ugh. Any quick repro steps? Is it consistent across seeds?

marta: Repro is pretty stable. Example failures show instruction-dropping and wrong-step ordering. Repro script: `eval-harness --model q6b-int4 --slice long-instr-chains --seed 42 --out failures.json`.

jen: For the golden set we should avoid naive dedupe that removes paraphrases. Those paraphrases are the failure triggers. Suggest: relaxed dedupe on long-instr and explicit human grouping.

lu: Agreed. Proposal: run two-tier dedupe: 1) strict fingerprint for shortctx, 2) fuzzy clustering for long-instr with sim threshold 0.78 and keep top-N per cluster. I can run it. Need to know cluster size target for canary (how many examples).

marta: Canary wants 700 high-signal cases double-reviewed. Overall golden refresh ~2k. For canary, prioritize examples with model delta >0.15 (measured by dialogue-coherence metric).

oliver: I'll wire the canary eval to emit a compact CSV with: id, sim_cluster, baseline_score, q6b-int4_score, delta, token_diff_sample. That'll make triage quicker.

jen: Labeling: we need updated guideline: mark partial-follow (score 2) when core intent preserved but step ordering off; hallucination flag when invented facts appear. I'll add a short doc.

labeler-bot: Available capacity: 24 annotators, 8 verifiers. ETA for 700 double-reviewed = ~60 hours if started now. Can scale to 36 annotators with manager approval, reducing ETA to ~36 hours.

jonathan: Approve scaling to 36 for this tranche. Ops: please let us know if infra cost is an issue.

lu: Starting partitioned dedupe now. Command: `curation run dedupe --partitions long-instr-chains --fuzzy-threshold 0.78 --keep-per-cluster 4 --out s3://curation/long-instr-candidates.json`. I'll post the S3 link when done (~3.5h).

oliver: ETA on harness today. I'll run baseline + int4 once Lu posts candidates. Will include token alignment diffs and a short human-readable summary for each fail.

marta: Action items: Lu = partitioned fuzzy-dedupe + export (~3.5h). Oliver = canary harness + baseline run after export. Jen = publish label guideline + brief for reviewers. Labeler-bot = spin up scaled pool once export appears. Marta/Jonathan = final go/no-go.

jen: I'll draft the guideline now and ping reviewer leads. Quick note: please include explicit examples of reordering errors so labelers have anchorcases.

marta: Thanks. If anyone spots other slices (multi-step math, code-infill) showing similar regressions, paste a sample here so we can expand cluster criteria. :mag:
